program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (pack-h grids gap)
      (let* ((h (apply max (map rows grids)))
             (w (+ (apply + (map cols grids)) (* gap (max 0 (- (length grids) 1))))))
        (let loop ([out (empty-grid h w 0)] [remaining grids] [left 0])
          (if (empty? remaining)
              out
              (let ((block (first remaining)))
                (loop (for*/fold ([acc out])
                                  ([r (in-range (rows block))]
                                   [c (in-range (cols block))]
                                   #:when (not (= (at block r c) 0)))
                        (set-cell acc r (+ left c) (at block r c)))
                      (rest remaining)
                      (+ left (cols block) gap)))))))
    (let* ((legend (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (row g 0)))
           (blocks
            (map (lambda (color)
                   (let* ((matches (filter (lambda (obj)
                                             (and (= (obj-color obj) color) (> (obj-r1 obj) 0)))
                                           (objects g 0)))
                          (chosen (first
                                   (sort matches
                                     (lambda (a b)
                                       (cond [(not (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))]
                                             [(not (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))) (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))]
                                             [else (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))]))))))
                     (subgrid g (obj-r1 chosen) (obj-c1 chosen) (obj-r2 chosen) (obj-c2 chosen))))
                 legend)))
      (pack-h blocks 1))))
